Package pkg_entities

Class MovingTrainer

java.lang.Object
pkg_entities.Trainer
pkg_entities.MovingTrainer
public class MovingTrainer extends Trainer
A trainer that can randomly move between connected rooms while the player explores.

Movement avoids teleporter rooms so wandering trainers stay reachable in normal map locations.

Version:
2026.05.08
Author:
Barnabe Jouanard
